CustomField.description: Position-restricted skills: TRUE when Restricted to Positions (Allowed_Positions__c) is filled. Exists so validation rules on other records can read the restriction across a lookup (Required_Skill__c.Required_Instruction__r, Chatbot_Instruction__c.Instruction_Dependency__r) without touching the multi-select picklist directly.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked automatically when Restricted to Positions is filled.
CustomField.label: Is Position Restricted
